name: Hardhead
rangeDescription: Timor-leste (eastern lesser sundas), australia (except driest areas) including tasmania, and banks islands (northern vanuatu)
description: Chocolate brown diving duck with white rump and large white panels in the wings. Male has white eyes.

name: Fruit-hunter
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed mountains of northern borneo (sabah)
description: Handsome and unmistakable thrush. Male is gray overall, whereas female is suffused with rusty cinnamon-brown.

name: Tenerife Blue Chaffinch
rangeDescription: Tenerife (canary islands)
description: Endemic to the island of Tenerife in the Canary Islands. Medium-sized finch with a strong and heavy bill and broken white eyering.

name: Red-fronted Antpecker
rangeDescription: Liberia (mount nimba) to southern mali and south-central ghana
description: A small, slender-billed warbler-like waxbill with pinkish-brown legs and different-looking sexes: the male has a red forehead, dull brown upperparts, light scaling on the face, and rusty-chestnut underparts, while the female has pale underparts with scattered dark chevrons, mostly brown upperparts, and a white-speckled head. Pairs and small groups forage alone or in mixed-species flocks, in the understory and middle levels of primary and swamp forest, often near water.

name: Peruvian Diving-Petrel
rangeDescription: Arid coasts of peru and northern chile
description: Very small diving seabird sometimes seen from shore, at time in small groups. Plumage is blackish above and whitish below; narrow whitish “braces” sometimes visible.

name: Fernwren
rangeDescription: Montane wet tropical zone of northeastern queensland
description: Small scrubwren-like bird found in wet rainforests at higher elevations in the Atherton Tablelands of far northern Queensland. Adult entirely brown except for white throat, black bib, and faint pale supercilium.

name: Whistling Kite
rangeDescription: Australia, new guinea, and new caledonia
description: Large sandy-colored raptor. In flight it has a strong underwing pattern, and holds its wings in a bent M-shape.

name: Tawny-crested Tanager
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern honduras to western ecuador; isla gorgona (off colombia)
description: Male is all black with a conspicuous orangey crest. Female is confusing: dark dull brown, with typical stout tanager bill.

name: Layard's Parakeet
rangeDescription: Sri lanka
description: Bright green, long-tailed parrot, with a gray hood and conspicuous black throat. The beak is red-orange in males, but all dark in duller females.

name: Barred Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: South-central china (southern gansu, southern shaanxi and western sichuan)
description: Pale brown laughingthrush with a pale face, black barring on the back, and a blue-gray wing panel. Handsome but shy and inconspicuous, foraging quietly on the ground and in shrubbery and thickets.

name: Eastern Double-collared Sunbird
rangeDescription: Highlands of kenya and northern tanzania
description: A medium-sized sunbird. Males are colorful, red and green, and females drab brownish.

name: Pale-headed Munia
rangeDescription: Scrub, marshes and ricefields of lowlands of mainland sulawesi and the lesser sundas from lombok eastward through babar
description: A small finch with a striking white head and dark body. Rich chestnut brown above, with reddish tail and pale peach-washed underside.

name: Semipalmated Sandpiper
rangeDescription: Breeds arctic north america; winters to southern south america
description: Small, grayish-brown sandpiper. Typically shows relatively short, blunt-tipped bill, but this varies across the breeding range: western populations are shortest-billed, eastern populations are longest, and females have longer bills than males!

name: Philippine Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: East-central and southern philippines (samar, leyte, mindanao, and negros) and sulu archipelago
description: A small bird of forests from the lowlands to low elevations in the mountains. Olive-green on the back with golden-olive wings and tail and a dark crown and eye-stripe.

name: Lesser Nothura
rangeDescription: Semiarid grassland and scrub of interior southeastern brazil and east-central paraguay
description: Sandy-colored tinamou that usually holds an upright posture. Has a brown crown and a heavily streaked back and throat.

name: Black-eared Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Australia
description: Small plain cuckoo with a dark eye and black

name: Gray Vireo
rangeDescription: Southwestern usa to northern baja california; winters to northern mexico (sonora)
description: One of North America's most nondescript birds: pale gray above, lighter whitish below, with a hint of pale spectacles and wingbars. Long-tailed for a vireo, but with a typically thick bill.

name: Common Loon
rangeDescription: Breeds in northern north america, southern greenland, and iceland; winters from southern alaska and the maritime provinces (canada) to northern mexico, and from iceland and scandinavia to the iberian peninsula
description: A large, heavy-billed loon. Common and widespread in North America; somewhat less common and more local in Europe.

name: Blue-winged Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Montane forest of nepal to southwestern china, myanmar, and northwestern tonkin
description: Brown laughingthrush with a black brow and a bright silvery-azure panel on the wing. Wings, belly, and rump are more rufous-tinged than the rest of the body.

name: Sao Paulo Bristle-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (espírito santo) to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Tiny flycatcher with a slender tail not usually held cocked. Olive above and on the breast with a yellow throat and belly.
